summary: Resize the current Chrome window from built-in device presets or your own saved sizes.
singlePurpose: Resize the current Chrome browser window to a user-selected saved width and height.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.justification: Stores the user's custom window-size presets and preferred preset order locally on their device.

remoteCode.justification: The extension does not use remote code. All executable JavaScript and CSS is included in the submitted package.

screenshots.title: Resize a Chrome window with one click from built-in presets.
screenshots.description: The popup shows the current browser size, built-in presets, and controls for creating and managing custom sizes.
